long_description.before:
Familiar is breaking down every language barrier. Live Shopping, Entertainment, Platforms, Education, Broadcasts.

Founders An Zhu Liu, Mingi Kwon, and Xu Zheng lead a team of PhDs, professors, and researchers from the world's top universities who started the field of joint audio-visual human models and co-authored the current state of the art in real-time human animation.

They're building world models for accurate humans: understanding, editing, and predicting. Dubbing is the first application, not the destination.

They started with video language translation, and they've already built one of the most accurate translators available today, the only one that works in real time. Everyone else scaffolds separate models and pre-processing; a world model just understands -- what the speaker means, from voice, person, and scene together. That's why the dub keeps the speaker's own voice, face, and delivery.

Vs ElevenLabs: they lose the laughter, the music, the ambiance -- 270% more background-sound error; ours sounds 27.8% more like you and makes 54.7% fewer translation errors. Vs human translators: 100.3% of their quality -- scalable, real time. Published benchmarks: https://thefamiliarlab.com/benchmark

The $14B spent on dubbing every year flips to AI once it's good enough. Live multiplies it.

🦋 Content in every language. Exactly the same as the original.

long_description.before: Lamb Labs is building custom chips for AI inference and the world's fastest LLM model at the lowest power. We've developed a new post-training technique that converts existing models to a diffusion-based architecture that delivers 2× faster inference on existing GPUs. We then build the hardware, custom silicon chips targeting up to 20,000+ tok/s and a 63× higher intelligence per watt.
long_description.after: Lamb Labs is building MPUs (Model Processing Units), custom chips that hardcode LLM weights directly into the chip. Unlike GPUs, which move weights between memory and compute, MPUs keep the model on-chip, targeting up to 20,000+ tok/s and a 63× higher intelligence per watt.

long_description.before:
Hubble retrieves complete medical records on behalf of patients using patient-mediated access. Under a patient's HIPAA right of access, they authorize us once and we pull their full history from every provider they've seen (hospitals, clinics, labs, imaging centers), no per-provider integration or IT project required.

Getting records today still runs on faxes, patient portals, and release-of-information queues, so teams that need medical data wait weeks and get back a pile of unstructured PDFs. Hubble handles the retrieval end to end and returns clean, structured records, turning what used to take weeks into days.

We work with teams that live or die on getting patient records fast: legal (personal injury, mass tort, disability), life sciences and research, and anyone building products that need a patient's real medical history to work. Instead of standing up records infrastructure themselves, they use Hubble as the retrieval layer.

We're the team behind the AI agents at Grow Therapy and Amazon's One Medical used by millions of patients (Prabha was Grow's first PM building their AI agents, Aaron built the AI infra serving 1M+ clients).
long_description.after: Hubble is the AI Plaid for healthcare: we use AI to retrieve patient medical records and deliver them to developers through a single API. We're the team behind the AI agents at Grow Therapy and Amazon's One Medical, used by millions of patients (Prabha was Grow's first PM building and scaling their AI agents, and Aaron built the AI infrastructure at One Medical serving 1M+ patients). Companies building in legal, life insurance underwriting, clinical trials, and digital health all need a patient's records to make decisions, but pulling that data out of thousands of EHRs and payors is still slow and manual. Our AI agents retrieve records the way a person would and normalize them into one clean API. We signed our first paying customers within three weeks of launching, all on usage-based pricing. https://hubble.ai

Petrarch brings internal company data to frontier labs, starting with manufacturing and industrial companies. We source data including codebases, project files, and payments from bankruptcy courts, then de-identify and prepare the data for model training.
